text: Power made deep in the mountains of Sichuan reaches Jiangsu, 2,000 km away, in just 7 milliseconds.
say: Power in Sichuan reaches Jiangsu, two thousand kilometres away, in seven milliseconds.
asr: Power in Sichuan reaches Jiangsu, 2,000 km away in 7ms.

text: The electricity in our homes swings back and forth as it flows. It's called alternating current, AC.
say: The electricity in our homes, swings back and forth. It's called alternating current.
asr: The electricity in our homes swings back and forth. It's called alternating current.

text: Sent that far as it is, a lot of it would simply be lost on the way.
So first it goes through a converter station and becomes direct current, DC, flowing one way only.
say: It goes through a converter station and becomes direct current, flowing one way only.
asr: It goes through a converter station and becomes direct current, flowing one way only.

text: Then it races along this line, more than 2,000 km long, all the way to Jiangsu.
say: Then it races along this line, more than two thousand kilometres, to Jiangsu.
asr: Then it races along this line, more than 2,000 kilometers, to Jiangsu.

text: The whole trip takes 7 milliseconds, less than the blink of an eye.
say: The whole trip takes seven milliseconds, less than the blink of an eye.

text: At the end it's turned back into AC, stepped down level by level, and sent to the socket in your wall.
say: At the end it's turned back into alternating current, stepped down level by level, and sent to the socket in your wall.
asr: At the end it's turned back into alternating current, stepped down level by level, and sent to the socket in your wall.

text: Plug in your phone charger, and inside it a tiny part called a bridge rectifier turns the AC back into DC.
say: Plug in your phone charger, and inside it a tiny part called a bridge rectifier turns the A C back into D C.

text: Believe it or not, it works on the same circuit principle as the giant, storeys tall, in the converter station.
asr: Believe it or not, it works on the same circuit principle as the giant, stories tall, in the converter station.

text: Only the station's power is a full 400 million times that of this little charger.
say: Only the station's power is a full four hundred million times that of this little charger.

text: Every bar of charge on your phone came this far, across mountains and rivers.
